title: 1967 Savoy College Reunion News
text:
WELCOME HALSELL EXES FRIENDS

Savoy College Reunion News

Number 1                    SAVOY, TEXAS                    July, 1967

All Roads Lead to Savoy
for Homecoming

SAVOY

HALSELL REUNION
JUNE 18

GLAD TO SEE YOU AGAIN!
notes: Cover page of newsletter. Decorative banner at top reads 'WELCOME HALSELL EXES FRIENDS'. Image shows a map of Texas with roads converging on Savoy, labeled 'All Roads Lead to Savoy for Homecoming'. Bottom banner reads 'GLAD TO SEE YOU AGAIN!'
